Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 10). Conceptual nth-plant design, 2,205 dry ton/day corn-stover biochemical ethanol plant, U.S., 2007 dollars (costs and MESP are 2007$). Main file: whole plant as fermenter_lignocellulosic-enzymatic (capacity, output, efficiency, biomass SEC, FCI, fixed and variable opex, lifetime, discount rate, construction time) and seven areas as partial units with installed cost from Table 28 and process temperatures and pressures from the design-basis tables (158 C pretreatment, 48 C hydrolysis, 32 C fermentation, 454 C steam). Flows: feed, chemicals, ethanol, net exported electricity, scrubber-vent CO2 and boiler steam per t ethanol (printed hourly flows divided by 21,808 kg/h ethanol). Not loaded: Area 100 feedstock handling and Area 700 storage, TCI and installed total (in other-values), sensitivity and target sections, Aspen appendices (equipment list, stream tables). Traps: (1) whole-plant capex (FCI 400.6) excludes Area 100 and is not the sum of the area installed costs (232.1 total) because of direct and indirect factors; (2) ethanol mass is read from the Fig. 18 stream label (21,808 kg/h), 61.0 MMgal/yr is printed; (3) electricity export 12,797 kW (Table 30) vs 41-28 = 13 MW differ by rounding and the separate Area 100 credit; (4) boiler efficiency (about 80%) has no heating-value basis; (5) energy balance values are LHV, 25 C reference, MMkcal/h; (6) the Area 300 min and max temperatures are two process steps, not a range of one step; (7) Area 800 carries two capacity rows (steam kg/h and power MW) in different units.
